evidence.d32_note: 32 is the fixture ceiling (TX-03 distances 2/5/6/8/20/32); the informative quantity is the fraction passing at d32.
evidence.cross_run_billing_rule: Cross-run billed-token comparisons are confounded even when prompts are byte-identical: C=48 bills 14679 here vs 15703 in E2 (U-SPCC-62) for byte-identical prompts (prompt_tokens match every turn); the gap is prefix-cache warmth. Only within-run comparisons are valid, and prompt tokens are the cache-independent measure. This qualifies E2's -5.72% claim (within-cell, stands) but no billed figure from one cell may be compared to another.
